Headline: Green Line Delays
ShortDescription: Some Green Line trains are running with residual delays and congestion following earlier signal problems near Garfield. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Some Green Line trains are running with residual delays and congestion following earlier signal problems near Garfield.

Shuttles buses from Garfield to Cottage Grove will remain in place until 815am.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
